name: Enese (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Enese (a blue shield with a yellow lion, with a helm, a figure crest and red, blue and yellow mantling) below the words ENESE KÖZÖSSÉGE in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Enese arms with helm, crest and mantling
